name: VideoGameQA-Bench-Metadata
description: A benchmark for question answering about video games that combines visual inputs (gameplay frames, trailers) with textual metadata to evaluate models' ability to answer questions about in-game events, mechanics, and narratives. It measures multimodal understanding, temporal reasoning, and domain-specific knowledge relevant to gaming scenarios.
reputation: A niche but growing benchmark used in multimodal VQA research focused on gaming content.
